detail:
Full summary: Updated the installed plugin to 1.16.0 at both user and project scope (project scope was pinned 1.13.0 and would have shadowed) and verified it: manifests pass, cache byte-identical to repo, installed hook binaries smoke-tested through all six gate lifecycle states — read-only and cross-session stops allow, edited-unrecorded blocks, record clears.
Findings: The 1.16.0 hooks took effect in the RUNNING session, not just after restart: the stop hook fired mid-session with the new marker-based message — ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} resolves to the updated cache at hook-fire time. The 'restart required' caveat applies to MCP server spawn and skill loading, not hook script resolution.; The first live firing of the marker-based gate was a true positive (this session's scratchpad Writes after the last record), and the PostToolUse activity marker had been written by the new hook — live confirmation of #43's fix behaving correctly in production.; Two plugin install scopes existed (user + project); the project-scope pin at 1.13.0 would have silently shadowed a user-scope update. When updating the plugin here, update both: claude plugin update twining@twining-marketplace, then again with --scope project.
